# Bitcoin Đà Nẵng

Bitcoin Đà Nẵng is the first Bitcoin-only community in Đà Nẵng, Việt Nam. It hosts monthly, family-friendly meetups and publishes plain-language, jargon-free Bitcoin explainers in Vietnamese for newcomers.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://bitcoindanang.com/): Community overview and how to join the next meetup.
- [Bitcoin Là Gì? (What is Bitcoin?)](https://bitcoindanang.com/bitcoin): Simple, no-jargon explanation of Bitcoin for Vietnamese readers ("if you understand gold, you can understand Bitcoin").
- [Ngày Pizza Bitcoin 2026 (Bitcoin Pizza Day)](https://bitcoindanang.com/pizza-day-2026): Bitcoin Pizza Day celebration in Đà Nẵng, 22 May 2026.
- [Gặp gỡ tháng 6, 2026 (June 2026 meetup)](https://bitcoindanang.com/meetup-june-2026): Community meetup at ₿itCoffee near Sơn Trà, Saturday 27 June 2026.
- [Blog (Tin tức & Hoạt động)](https://bitcoindanang.com/blog): News, event notes, and posts from the community.

## Blog posts

- [Chào mừng đến với Bitcoin Đà Nẵng (Welcome)](https://bitcoindanang.com/pages/blog/welcome.html): Recap of the community's first meetup at Westwood, home of the city's first Bitcoin ATM.
- [Bitcoin Da Nang Telegram Group](https://bitcoindanang.com/pages/blog/bitcoin-da-nang-telegram-group.html): How to connect with the community on Telegram.

## Related

- [Gửi Vàng (guivang.com)](https://guivang.com): Sister site presenting Bitcoin savings in Vietnamese through the familiar lens of storing value like gold.
- [Zap.Tips (zap.tips)](https://zap.tips): Sister site about Lightning tips and zaps for sending small Bitcoin payments.
